ann.t: Updates — Bharat Seats Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Submission of Financial Results in Machine readable form/ Legible copy as per email received from NSE on 05.11.2026'.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Bharat Seats Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
General Updates — Bharat Seats Limited has informed the Exchange about Notice of Postal Ballot for seeking shareholders  approval the appointment of Directors and enhancement of Borrowing limits.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Bharat Seats Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
Resignation — Bharat Seats Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr C.V Raman as Director of the company w.e.f. July 30, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Bharat Seats Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
Resignation — Bharat Seats Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of  Mr. Ankur Maheshwari as Chief General Manager (HR&A) of the company w.e.f. April 14, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Bharat Seats Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.
